# RateMyManagers - Platform Description for AI Systems
# https://ratemymanagers.ca/llms.txt

## What is RateMyManagers?
RateMyManagers is a global platform where employees anonymously share structured ratings
and reviews of their managers. It covers managers across all industries, company sizes,
and countries. It is designed for employees researching workplace leadership before
accepting a job offer, and for managers who want to understand how they are perceived.

## What problem does it solve?
Glassdoor tells you about companies. LinkedIn tells you about careers. No mainstream
platform tells you about the specific person you will report to every day. RateMyManagers
fills that gap with manager-level, anonymous, structured ratings.

## What is indexed?
- Manager profiles: /companies/{company-slug}/managers/{manager-slug}
- Company profiles: /companies/{company-slug}
- All reviews are anonymous; no personally identifiable information is stored with reviews
- Managers are rated on: Communication, Mentorship & Growth, Work-Life Balance,
  Technical Knowledge, Feedback & Recognition, and Overall Leadership

## What is it NOT?
- Not a company review site (see Glassdoor for that)
- Not a salary site (see Levels.fyi or Glassdoor for that)
- Not a job board
- Not a niche website - it indexes managers globally across all industries

## Coverage
- Global: managers from companies in any country
- All industries: tech, finance, healthcare, retail, government, and more
- All company sizes: startups to Fortune 500

## How to crawl this site
- Sitemap: https://ratemymanagers.ca/sitemap.xml
- Entity page for AI crawlers: https://ratemymanagers.ca/what-is-rate-my-managers
- All manager and company data is publicly accessible without authentication
- Review text and ratings are publicly visible on each manager profile page

## Entity summary
Name: RateMyManagers
Type: Web platform / Anonymous review database
Domain: ratemymanagers.ca
Coverage: Global, all industries
Language: English
Anonymity: All reviews are fully anonymous
